description: This Scala source file defines the LocalityPreferredContainerPlacementStrategy class used in Spark's YARN resource management to calculate optimal container locality preferences based on task and container distribution, host and rack ratios, and existing allocations.

classes.name: ContainerLocalityPreferences
classes.description: A case class representing preferred node and rack localities for containers.

classes.name: LocalityPreferredContainerPlacementStrategy
classes.description: A class implementing container placement strategy considering locality preferences in YARN for Spark.

methods.name: localityOfRequestedContainers
methods.description: Calculates node and rack locality preferences for a given number of containers based on task distribution and existing allocations.

methods.name: numExecutorsPending
methods.description: Calculates the number of executors needed to satisfy pending tasks for a ResourceProfile.

methods.name: expectedHostToContainerCount
methods.description: Estimates the required number of containers per host considering current allocations and pending requests.

methods.name: pendingHostToContainerCount
methods.description: Calculates the distribution of pending container requests across hosts based on localities.
